message.title: Contract extension for Haven
message.body:
Jacktel is pleased to announce that the firm period of the contract at Valhall for AkerBP has been extended from 15 months to 21 months. Haven was successfully installed and gangway connected on 2 June at the Valhall field.  The firm period of the contract ends 29 February 2028. In addition, Jacktel has granted AkerBP 4x1 month options which could extend the contract until 30 June 2028.
